instruction: Connect the circuit as per the forward bias diagram with 1N4007 diode, 1k resistor, and RPS.
Vary the DC power supply voltage in steps of 0.1V from 0V to 1V and note diode voltage and current.
Reconnect the diode in reverse bias and measure reverse saturation current for voltages 0V to 15V.
Plot Vf vs If on linear graph paper and calculate the static and dynamic resistance.
Connect the secondary of the step-down transformer to the diode and load resistor RL.
Observe input AC and output pulsating DC waveforms on the Digital Storage Oscilloscope (DSO).
Connect a 10uF filter capacitor in parallel with RL and note the reduced ripple waveform on DSO.
Launch Code Composer Studio and create a new C/DSP project targeting TMS320C6748.
Define input sequences x = [1, 2, 3, 4] and h = [1, 1, 1].
Implement linear convolution algorithm and observe output buffer y in Memory Watch window.
Enter 8086 machine codes or assemble mnemonic program using DEBUG or ALS-8086 monitor.
Set input operands at source memory offsets 2000H and 2002H.
Execute program using GO command and inspect destination registers and memory address 2004H.
Open Cadence / EDA tool or breadboard CD4007 CMOS array with Vdd = 5V.
Sweep input voltage Vin from 0V to 5V in steps of 0.2V and measure output Vout.
Record VIL, VIH, VOL, VOH from the slope = -1 tangents on the VTC curve and calculate noise margins.
Write Verilog HDL module for 1-bit full adder and instantiate 4 units for 4-bit ripple carry adder.
Create behavioral testbench with all combinations of 4-bit inputs A and B and verify in simulation waveform.
Assign FPGA physical I/O pins to slide switches (inputs) and LEDs (outputs) in UCF / XDC constraint file.
Synthesize, generate bitstream, and download to Spartan-6 FPGA board via JTAG cable.
